import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

runtime = Path("src/do_again/browser/runtime.py")
tests = Path("tests/test_browser.py")

text = runtime.read_text()

text = text.replace(
'''    if not wait_for_response:
        return {
            "response": "",
            "chat_url": target.url,
        }
''',
'''    if not wait_for_response:
        return {
            "response": "submitted",
            "chat_url": target.url,
        }
''',
1)

old_primary = '''    try:
        send_message(target, message, timeout=180.0, wait_for_response=False)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 20.0
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if _page_contains(target, marker + " state="):
                return {"response": "delivered", "chat_url": target.url}
            time.sleep(0.5)
        raise BrowserError("receipt notification was submitted but did not appear in the conversation")
'''
new_primary = '''    try:
        return send_message(
            target,
            message,
            timeout=180.0,
            wait_for_response=False,
        )
'''
if old_primary not in text:
    raise SystemExit("primary polling block not found")
text = text.replace(old_primary, new_primary, 1)

old_retry = '''        send_message(target, message, timeout=180.0, wait_for_response=False)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 20.0
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if _page_contains(target, marker + " state="):
                return {"response": "delivered", "chat_url": target.url}
            time.sleep(0.5)
        raise BrowserError("receipt notification was submitted but did not appear in the conversation")
'''
new_retry = '''        return send_message(
            target,
            message,
            timeout=180.0,
            wait_for_response=False,
        )
'''
if old_retry not in text:
    raise SystemExit("retry polling block not found")
text = text.replace(old_retry, new_retry, 1)

runtime.write_text(text)

test_text = tests.read_text()
old_test = '''                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime._page_contains", side_effect=[False, True]),
                    patch(
                        "do_again.browser.runtime.send_message",
                        return_value={"response": "", "chat_url": target.url},
                    ) as send_mock,
                ):
                    value = notify_receipt(repo, {"request_id": "req-fast", "state": "succeeded"})
            self.assertEqual(value["response"], "delivered")
            self.assertEqual(send_mock.call_count, 1)
            self.assertFalse(send_mock.call_args.kwargs["wait_for_response"])
'''
new_test = '''                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime._page_contains", return_value=False),
                    patch(
                        "do_again.browser.runtime.send_message",
                        return_value={"response": "submitted", "chat_url": target.url},
                    ) as send_mock,
                ):
                    value = notify_receipt(repo, {"request_id": "req-fast", "state": "succeeded"})
            self.assertEqual(value["response"], "submitted")
            self.assertEqual(send_mock.call_count, 1)
            self.assertFalse(send_mock.call_args.kwargs["wait_for_response"])
'''
if old_test not in test_text:
    raise SystemExit("fastpath regression test block not found")
test_text = test_text.replace(old_test, new_test, 1)
tests.write_text(test_text)

subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "add", str(runtime), str(tests)], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "Complete receipt delivery on accepted submission"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)

print("HEAD=" + subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
print("STATUS=")
print(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--short"], text=True))
